limits.title: Limits
limits.rate: Each key defaults to <mono>10</mono> requests per second. Beyond that it returns <mono>429</mono> with <mono>x-ratelimit-limit</mono> / <mono>x-ratelimit-remaining</mono> / <mono>x-ratelimit-reset</mono> and <mono>retry-after</mono>.
limits.quota: A key can also carry a total and a daily quota; the daily quota resets at midnight UTC. Hitting it returns <mono>402 key_quota_exceeded</mono>; an empty balance returns <mono>402 insufficient_balance</mono>. Call <mono>GET {base}/limits</mono> with the same key for the values in force.
